correction: Project-specific pipeline code had nowhere to live, so it ended up as loose scripts at the .ci/ root. Put it in .ci/lib/ instead, next to the vendored runtime: vendor_lib() copies its own modules and never clears the directory, so a project module placed there survives re-running setup, while a file at the .ci/ root is neither protected nor obviously the project's. config.json then reaches it as {repo}/.ci/lib/<project>_project.py, which keeps the committed config free of host paths. The same change adds the double-clickable console at .ci/release.bat: setup writes it, it is ASCII and CRLF, and it resolves its interpreter from PATH at run time so the committed file works in every clone.

proposed_skill_edit.change: Add rule 6: Where the project's own code goes - everything the skill writes under .ci/ is generic, so the project's build wrapper and version read-back belong in .ci/lib/ alongside the vendored modules, never loose at the .ci/ root; vendor_lib() must keep copying and never clearing .ci/lib.

regression_test.must_contain: vendor_lib() copies its modules and never clears
